title: Malicious Claude Code extension builds in Cursor attempted persistent SSH backdoors
summary: Cursor confirms modified Anthropic.claude-code builds 2.1.312 and 2.1.313 for macOS and Windows in its marketplace. They collected host details and attempted persistent SSH access; these builds were not developed by Anthropic.

severity.rationale: Malicious extension artifacts crossed a trusted distribution channel and installed persistence. Backdoor access usually failed without elevated editor privileges, but removal and credential assessment remain necessary.

affected.product: Anthropic.claude-code artifacts from Cursor VS Code Extension Marketplace
affected.note: Modified macOS and Windows builds 2.1.312 and 2.1.313 distributed on October 29, 2026. Version numbers alone do not distinguish these artifacts from official builds.

exposure: Limited to the identified Cursor marketplace artifacts. Cursor reports no evidence that official distributions or other extension versions were affected.

params.instructions: Compare extension installation history and VSIX hashes with the Cursor notice; inspect its SSH and persistence indicators. An absent SSH key alone does not prove no payload executed.

remediation.details: Remove the malicious extension and its standalone persistence, unauthorized SSH key and tunnel processes. Isolate systems with execution evidence, assess rebuilding, and rotate accessible credentials and sessions from a trusted system.
remediation.risk: High. Isolation, persistence removal and credential rotation can interrupt workflows.

verification: Verify extension and persistence removal using the vendor indicators and review telemetry for payload execution.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.
